notes: Price $15.77 close 2026-10-02. Revenue = GAAP total net revenue (net of interest expense; bank holding company); Q4 derived as FY minus 9M. Revenue model transactional by instruction: lending (net interest income + loan sales) plus fee-based platform/financial-services revenue. Guidance is annual only (FY26 adjusted net revenue $4.75-4.85B, raised 2026-07-29) -> next-Q guidance null, provides_guidance true. Gross margin null: not meaningful for a bank (cost of funds/credit losses). Adj. operating margin = Q2'26 adjusted EBITDA / adjusted net revenue (357.8/1,205.6 = 29.7%); GAAP margin = pre-tax income/total net revenue (204.3/1,218.7). FCF margin null: GAAP OCF TTM -$8,502M is driven by originations of loans held for sale, not comparable. Capex TTM 290.5 (purchases of property, equipment, software and capitalized software; 6.7% of TTM revenue 4,305.7). Net cash null: bank balance sheet (deposits/warehouse debt) not comparable. Customer concentration null: 10-K says no third-party loan buyer >=10% of consolidated net revenue. Founder-led false: CEO Anthony Noto is not a founder. TTM diluted EPS $0.49 = H1'26 0.24 + FY25 0.39 - H1'25 0.14 (sum of reported EPS). Prior TTM $0.50 inflated by Q4'24 tax valuation-allowance benefit (FY24 tax expense -$265M), so EPS growth (-2%) understates: TTM pre-tax income 737.7 vs 315.8 (+134%). ev_ntm_sales set to forward P/S (mcap/NTM consensus revenue) because bank EV is not meaningful. Red flag heavy_dilution: Q2'26 diluted weighted shares 1,352.0M vs 1,182.9M in Q2'25 (+14.3%), after ~$1.5B offering completed 2026-01-05 (57.75M sh at $27.50) on top of July 2025 raise. Also note: Muddy Waters short report (2026-03-17) alleging accounting/charge-off presentation issues; SoFi rejected the claims; no restatement, so not flagged.
